test.title: OP-DOC-01 real schema and confirmation preserve exact evidence through source revocation

artifacts.evidence: Timeout waiting for exact getByLabel('Risk rating'); page accessibility snapshot contains a combobox named Risk rating.
New supplier form visibly contains the Risk rating select with Choose…; preceding inputs were filled.
0-trace.trace call@38 is the timed-out internal:label selector. Frame snapshot after@call@20 contains the exact create form and wrapped select/options below.
Original DOC identity, 60000 ms timeout, retry0 and timedOut result.

observed_dom.label_html: <label>Risk rating<select name="riskRating"><option value="" selected>Choose…</option><option value="Low">Low</option><option value="Medium">Medium</option><option value="High">High</option></select></label>

diagnosis.cause: The exact label selector compares the wrapping label text, which includes its nested select option text. The visible/accessible name remained Risk rating; it was not renamed to Risk.
diagnosis.evidence_chain: runtime/ui.ts wraps each select and its option children in a label. The retained DOM snapshot includes Choose…/Low/Medium/High inside that label, while the page accessibility snapshot exposes the control as combobox 'Risk rating'. The locator remained unresolved until the original 60000 ms budget expired.
diagnosis.phase: Before supplier creation submission and before upload, scanner admission, document extraction or confirmation.
diagnosis.ownership: Operations helper locator defect; no domain/shared producer change justified.
diagnosis.robust_replacement: Use the exact observed accessible role/name scoped to the same unique create form. This avoids matching option text as part of the label while preserving strict uniqueness and the same Low option selection.

source_evidence.finding: fields() renders the select with all option elements nested inside its label.
Supplier field mapping is riskRating: 'Risk rating', with options empty, Low, Medium, High.

postimage.text: await create.getByRole("combobox", { name: "Risk rating", exact: true }).selectOption("Low")

patch.comparison:
-  await create.getByLabel("Risk rating", { exact: true }).selectOption("Low")
+  await create.getByRole("combobox", { name: "Risk rating", exact: true }).selectOption("Low")
patch.eof: Official preimage and postimage both end with a single LF after the closing brace. A separately materialized local baseline had an extra LF; it is not the official preimage.
